title: Deepika Padukone Heads to Bengaluru Ahead of Second Baby's Arrival as Ranveer Singh Sees Her Off
excerpt: The actress, currently in her third trimester, traveled to her hometown for the final weeks of pregnancy while continuing to balance a packed professional calendar.
body:
• Deepika Padukone has traveled to Bengaluru ahead of her second baby's arrival, with husband Ranveer Singh seeing her off at the airport.
  • The couple announced their second pregnancy in April 2026 through an Instagram post featuring daughter Dua holding a positive pregnancy test.
  • Deepika has continued filming King alongside Shah Rukh Khan during her pregnancy and has Raaka with Allu Arjun lined up.
  • Ranveer Singh is riding high on the success of Dhurandhar, which has collected over Rs 1,748 crore in worldwide gross.

Heading Home for the Final Stretch

Deepika Padukone, currently in her third trimester, has headed to Bengaluru ahead of her second child's arrival, according to NDTV. Husband Ranveer Singh was photographed seeing her off at the Mumbai airport in what has become one of the most closely watched celebrity pregnancy journeys in recent Bollywood memory.

https://x.com/IndiaLiveIN/status/2088951406161953047

The trip to Bengaluru — where Deepika's parents, former badminton champion Prakash Padukone and Ujjala Padukone, reside — follows an Indian tradition of expectant mothers spending the final weeks of pregnancy with their maternal family. The couple's first child, daughter Dua Padukone Singh, was born in Mumbai on September 8, 2024.

The Announcement That Broke the Internet

"Ranveer Singh is riding high on the success of Dhurandhar, which has collected over Rs 1,748 crore in worldwide gross."

Deepika and Ranveer announced their second pregnancy on April 19 through a joint Instagram post that quickly went viral. The image showed their daughter Dua holding a positive pregnancy test kit, with both parents' hands gently supporting her. Deepika captioned the post with two evil eye emojis, keeping it characteristically understated.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=24zl0xC-4SI

The announcement drew an immediate wave of congratulations from colleagues including Parineeti Chopra, Samantha Ruth Prabhu, Ananya Panday, Kiara Advani, and Sonam Kapoor. Fans flooded the comments calling it a "healing moment."

In July, Deepika shared a relatable glimpse into her third trimester by reposting a humorous reel about the nightly struggle of walking to the bathroom — a candid update that resonated with expectant mothers everywhere.

Balancing Motherhood and a Packed Slate

Despite her advancing pregnancy, Deepika has maintained a demanding professional schedule. She recently completed a major shooting schedule for King, the international action thriller alongside Shah Rukh Khan and his daughter Suhana Khan, returning from a South Africa shoot earlier this year. A behind-the-scenes clip from a commercial shoot in Bengaluru also went viral in recent weeks.

Her upcoming projects include Raaka, directed by Atlee and co-starring Allu Arjun, as well as a special appearance in Love and War. Earlier this year, Deepika spoke about how motherhood had profoundly changed her perspective, saying it made her more patient and pushed her out of her comfort zone.

Ranveer's Blockbuster Year

Ranveer Singh, meanwhile, is enjoying one of the most commercially successful periods of his career. His recent film Dhurandhar: The Revenge has collected over Rs 1,748 crore in worldwide gross, according to Sacnilk estimates, cementing his position among Bollywood's top draws. He is also preparing for Pralay, a zombie adventure thriller featuring Kalyani Priyadarshan.

The couple, who married in a private ceremony at Lake Como, Italy on November 14 and 15, 2018, have consistently been protective of their daughter Dua's privacy. While they share occasional updates, they have never shown her face in public photographs — a boundary they appear set to maintain with their second child as well.

What's Next

With the baby expected in the coming weeks, Deepika is likely to take a brief pause from professional commitments before returning to promotional duties for King, which is slated for a Christmas Eve release. Ranveer, who has been spotted being characteristically protective at every public appearance, will divide his time between Mumbai and Bengaluru as the family prepares to welcome their newest member.
